Erin Emott (she/her) is a 4th year PhD candidate at North Carolina State University working in Bill Hoffmann's lab. Her research focuses on population-, community-, and ecosystem-level responses to variation in stand density and composition in longleaf pine ecosystems. 

I'm also a studio pottery and ceramics teacher, the Treasurer of the Plant Biology graduate student association, and a Grad Peer Mentor through the College of Agriculture and Life Sciences.
